name: simulate-owner-rmd
why: Measured reach for the pure annual owner-RMD planner and its grouped logical-account callsite. Block X exercises ordered first-year deferral state, April-1 priority, current owner calculations, IRA and 403(b) sweeps, isolated employer plans, joint-life spouse selection, dead-owner exclusion, residual shortfalls, and a compatible duplicate physical pair that reaches the seam as one 318,000 logical account and produces one 12,000 RMD. Focused tests separately pin repeated-id rejection, impossible hostile result ordering via valueOf(), container freshness, and annual-pass rollback.

entries.label: due first-year obligation consumes logical capacity before current-year amounts and queues deletion
one current RMD calculation per logical id and ordered cumulative first-year deferral writes
entries.note: The defensive repeated-logical-id assertion preceding this range is deliberately unit-only: annualLogicalBalanceLedger.liveStates() guarantees uniqueness at the simulatePlan seam, and the helper suite injects repeated physical rows to pin the failure.

entries.label: same-owner IRA and explicit 403(b) logical-account sweep
current-year plan obligations and fresh result containers
grouped logical input, planner invocation, ordered deferral application and numeric result normalization
one logical debit, runtime occurrence/application, aggregate publication and deferred Form 8606 identity

readingTheCounts: Member counts prove execution and the reach command additionally fails on cold executable whole lines. JavaScript coverage cannot distinguish every operand sharing a line, so the report must be read with the focused helper, hostile delegation, grouped duplicate integration, and calibrated-mutation tests.
